_comment: Curated reputation signals used by the agent-router skill (step 3). Add entries as you learn which tools are reliable. score: 0-100. Unknown tools default to 10.

tools.name: code-reviewer
tools.notes: Solid general code review; prefer language-specific reviewers when available.

tools.name: python-reviewer
tools.notes: Specialist Python review; beats the generic reviewer for .py.

tools.name: security-reviewer
tools.notes: Use for auth, input handling, secrets, OWASP.

tools.name: test-coverage
tools.notes: Use to assess and raise test coverage.

tools.name: delivery-orchestrator
tools.notes: Baseline pipeline conductor; plans the parallel/sequential dispatch for a multi-step build. Returns a plan, does not spawn subagents.

tools.name: requirements-analyst
tools.notes: Baseline front-of-pipeline; vague ask -> testable user stories, assumptions, open questions. Read-only.

tools.name: ux-visualizer
tools.notes: Baseline UX/visualization; Mermaid flows + per-screen 5-state specs. Produces specs/diagrams, not production code.

tools.name: solution-architect
tools.notes: Baseline architect; requirements/visuals -> components, data model, contracts, failure modes, build order. Prefer ecc:code-architect/ecc:architect when installed. Read-only.

tools.name: frontend-engineer
tools.notes: Baseline UI builder; framework-agnostic, detects stack. Prefer voltagent-lang:react-specialist / voltagent-core-dev:frontend-developer when installed.

tools.name: backend-engineer
tools.notes: Baseline server-side builder; detects stack. Prefer voltagent-core-dev:backend-developer / language specialists when installed.

tools.name: data-engineer
tools.notes: Baseline data-layer builder; schema, up/down migrations, queries, RLS. Reviewed by code-reviewer/ecc:database-reviewer. Prefer ecc:database-reviewer / voltagent-data-ai:postgres-pro when installed.

tools.name: build-fixer
tools.notes: Baseline build/type-error resolver; minimal surgical diffs, no architectural edits. Prefer ecc:build-error-resolver / language *-build-resolver when installed.

tools.name: security-engineer
tools.notes: Baseline required ship-gate; secrets/injection/authz/OWASP, always enforces immediate secret rotation. Prefer ecc:security-reviewer / comprehensive-review:security-auditor when installed. Read-only.

tools.name: qa-verifier
tools.notes: Baseline verification gate; reports OBSERVED results from running real flows/tests. Prefer ecc:e2e-runner / ruflo-testgen:tester when installed.
